Who It's For

Every Group, Every Time Slot

Friends & Couples

Light, social, and easy to share. Ages 18 to 34, after work or on weekends.

Teens

Ages 12 and up can come in on their own. A place to hang out after school.

Families

A half-day weekend destination for parents and kids, with a dedicated Kid Zone.

Parties & Teams

Team building, school outings and birthday parties, with party rooms and karaoke.

For Groups

Groups & Team Building

Bring the whole crew. Compete, cheer and celebrate together in one place.

01

Team Building

Turn a company day into a real match. Friendly competition across courts, baseball and arcade brings teams closer.

02

School Outing

An active day out for school groups, with something for every age.

03

Party rooms and karaoke make birthdays easy to celebrate with friends and family.

Company days and client outings with a venue that gets everyone moving.
